descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S30 Existing unit specs (unit.config.ts): attempt counts and time limits — photo reading retried once with no fallback, a slow Haiku not asked again, deadlines from the budget, voice connect retried once, a dropped recordin …

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 A failure during photo capture: photo reading retries automatically; if it still fails, a clear message shows, nothing is added, and the photo isn't lost (UAT OAT-03 step 7; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 4; UAT Empty & Failure States (Photo capture); TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 state 7)
  • U12 A failure during voice transcription: transcription retries automatically; the audio is kept until transcription succeeds; if it still fails, a clear message shows and the dictation isn't lost (UAT OAT-03 step 7; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 4; TFA-94745 AC 4)
  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state (UAT OAT-03 step 4; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94422 AC 5)
  • U5 When the primary model (Haiku) is forced to fail or time out, Haiku is retried once, then the same call goes to Mistral (UAT OAT-03 step 6; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3; TFA-94422 AC 2)
  • T3 The full retry sequence stays within about 30 s (TFA-94422 AC 7; UAT 3.5)
  • U7 The output records which model produced it; each run records which AI ran each step (note model, speech-to-text engine, pre-round model, photo model, Ask AI model) (UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3; UAT 3.1; UAT 3.9; TFA-94422 AC 6; TFA-94423 AC 7)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given e2e/unit at origin/main e02167f, run with 'playwright test --config e2e/unit.config.ts' (not in cases/e2e-titles.tsv, not run by spec-matrix.mjs)

When Run the titles below

Then RT-05: without a fallback (the vision path) a temporary failure is retried once, then thrown. RT-07: a primary that took 10 s or more to fail is not asked again and the time goes to the fallback. RT-08: each attempt's deadline comes from what is left of the 30 s budget, never below 8 s. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions. Deterministic evidence for OAT-03 step 7 (U11 server retry, U12 connect retry and kept audio) and for T3 / Q4 (RT-07, RT-08); it does not show the screen (S18, S19) or a real microphone (S19). RT-07 is the rule Q4 asks about: recorded as main's behaviour, not judged

Where it ran: local newspec-a (new Playwright specs); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S30 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-a.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-a.

UAT item: OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-03/S30

Existing unit specs (unit.config.ts): attempt counts and time limits — photo reading retried once with no fallback, a slow Haiku not asked again, deadlines from the budget, voice connect retried once, a dropped recording kept

Tickets: TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa); TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-a: status passed in newspec-a/results.json → passed (passed).

How it is tested (newspec-a/plan.json, automatable: yes): Run the twelve existing unit titles with 'playwright test --config e2e/unit.config.ts -g <titles>' in the QA worktree; verdict = Playwright assertions. RT-07 is recorded, not judged (Q4). — In-process unit tests; spec-matrix.mjs simply never ran the unit config.

Detail:

All 12 unit titles pass with --config e2e/unit.config.ts (RT-05, RT-07, RT-08 x2, RT-10 x2, six live-dictation / live-session titles). RT-07 (a primary that took >= 10 s is not asked again) is recorded as main's behaviour, not judged (Q4).

Evidence: 1 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (unit specs, e2e/unit.config.ts): in-process unit tests of the QA worktree's code that touch no deployment, so a dev run adds nothing; they run locally only (Quinn 2026-10-14), once spec-matrix.mjs can run the unit project (scripted-spec).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
